research_role: Modeling energy demand as a function of thermal load, humidity, and HVAC operation
scientific_interpretation: Strong relationship observed between thermal variables (temperature, HVAC usage) and energy consumption. In Journey to Zero, outdoor temperature exhibits an inverse correlation with heating/cooling seasonal loads. In Building Energy, HVAC activation drives significant energy increases. Note: These datasets represent HVAC building loads and grid demand, which validate multi-factor energy modeling, but do NOT replace physical cold-chain compressor thermodynamics.
